Removed duplicate 'reconstruction accuracy' entry and normalized capitalization. All metrics are explicitly used to evaluate generated outputs in the paper.
No LLMs are used as judges/evaluators in this paper - the models are trained as generators on formal languages.
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper - all evaluation is automated using validity, reconstruction accuracy, and correlation metrics.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on mechanistic interpretability using sparse autoencoders (SAEs) on formal language generation tasks. While it addresses NLG (generation of formal language sequences), the primary focus is on interpretability and causality analysis rather than improving generation quality. The automatic metrics used are specifically designed for the formal language domain (validity, grammaticality scores) rather than standard NLG metrics like BLEU/ROUGE.
